# dtcloud_lbs (Data Source)

Lists the load balancers in the active region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dtcloud_lbs" "all" {}

output "load_balancers" {
  value = [for lb in data.dtcloud_lbs.all.load_balancers : "${lb.name}  ${lb.ip_address}  ${lb.status}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `load_balancers` (List of Object) The load balancers visible to the caller. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--load_balancers))

<a id="nestedatt--load_balancers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `load_balancers`

Read-Only:

- `flavor_name` (String)
- `floating_ip` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `ip_address` (String)
- `members_total` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `network` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--load_balancers--network))
- `port_id` (String)
- `status` (String)

<a id="nestedobjatt--load_balancers--network"></a>
### Nested Schema for `load_balancers.network`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `ip` (String)
- `name` (String)

## Behaviour worth knowing

* **The list endpoint reports a display shape**, flatter than the details one. For everything about a
  single load balancer, use `dtcloud_lb`.
* **The id is a hash of the results**, so an unchanged list does not show up as a diff.
